svp.strategySummary: Designed a 4-master visual set for the 5 Instagram cards plus Threads slot 0 reuse. Card-01 (hero_cover) uses a dedicated editorial sunny beach master. Threads slot 0 reuses card-01's master as it aligns with the opening hook. Card-02 (bridge_statement) and card-03 (cultural_context) are split into distinct masters to satisfy neighbor-aware differentiation: card-02 focuses on a wide mountainous geographic transition (layered misty ridges along the northern border), while card-03 focuses on a close-up highland lived-environment view (cultivated mountain slopes and settlement structure near Lang Son) rather than collapsing into the same scenic geography. Card-04 (evidence_detail) uses an exclusive rammed-earth architectural detail master in object_or_detail mode. Card-05 (typography_anchor) sets generatedVisualNeeded to false (with a decisionTrace override) to use a clean minimalist typographic closing layout.

card-01.intent: Sunny tropical beach resort in Vietnam with palm trees and turquoise water, establishing the familiar tourist framing.

card-02.intent: Wide scenic geography of misty mountain ridges along the northern border of Vietnam with an overcast sky showing a transition from coastal to alpine terrain.

card-03.intent: Highland lived environment near Lang Son showing terraced cultivated plots, traditional paths, and highland settlement structure reflecting minority community life.

card-04.intent: Close-up architectural detail of a traditional rammed-earth wall (nhà trình tường) showing coarse earthen texture, layered compaction marks, and sturdy timber integration.

card-05.intent: Clean minimalist typographic closing layout with a subtle earthy gradient background summarizing the expanded perspective on Vietnam travel.

overrides.reason: Typography anchor uses a minimalist text layout without image generation.

card02.visualIntent: Wide scenic geography of misty mountain ridges along the northern border of Vietnam with an overcast, atmospheric sky showing a clear topographical transition from coastal lowlands to rugged alpine terrain. Atmosphere/lighting: Soft, diffused overcast daylight with low-hanging mountain fog and cool blue-gray atmospheric tones.

card03.visualIntent: Highland lived environment near Lang Son featuring rolling terraced cultivated plots, traditional beaten earth paths, and rustic hillside settlement structures reflecting minority community architecture. Atmosphere/lighting: Natural early morning or late afternoon natural side lighting that accentuates the textured contours of the hillside terraces.
